arguments.command:
python3 -c "
from funcy import autocurry

# Test with keyword-only args
def foo(a, *, b=10, c=20):
    return (a, b, c)

curried = autocurry(foo)
print('Type of curried:', type(curried))
result1 = curried(1)
print('Result of curried(1):', result1)
print('Type of curried(1):', type(result1))
result2 = curried(1)(b=2)
print('Result of curried(1)(b=2):', result2)
print('Type of curried(1)(b=2):', type(result2))
result3 = curried(1)(b=2)(c=3)
print('Result of curried(1)(b=2)(c=3):', result3)
print('Result of curried(1, b=2, c=3):', curried(1, b=2, c=3))
"
